sourceTitle: Transform a quick drawing into a live app with Gemini.
originalTitle: Transform a quick drawing into a live app with Gemini.

blocks.text: Great app ideas often start on paper. Turn them into interactive tools with Gemini.
blocks.zh: 伟大的应用创意经常从纸上开始.把它们变成Gemini的互动工具.
blocks.en: Great app ideas often start on paper. Turn them into interactive tools with Gemini.

blocks.text: Upload a photo of your sketch, like an app mock-up, habit tracker, or game board to Gemini.
blocks.zh: 上传一张你的素描照片,像一个应用程序模拟,习惯跟踪器,或游戏板给Gemini。
blocks.en: Upload a photo of your sketch, like an app mock-up, habit tracker, or game board to Gemini.

blocks.text: Select the Canvas tool and ask Gemini: "Can you code this app?" Gemini reads your visual and writes the code.
blocks.zh: 选择 Canvas 工具并询问Gemini :Gemini读取你的视觉并写下代码。
blocks.en: Select the Canvas tool and ask Gemini: "Can you code this app?" Gemini reads your visual and writes the code.

blocks.text: Test your tool in the preview window. Gemini can adjust colors, fonts, or features in real time.
blocks.zh: 在预览窗口中测试您的工具 。Gemini可以调整颜色,字体,则或特性在实时。
blocks.en: Test your tool in the preview window. Gemini can adjust colors, fonts, or features in real time.

blocks.text: Next time inspiration strikes, bring it to life with Gemini.
blocks.zh: 下一次的灵感冲击,与Gemini相生.
blocks.en: Next time inspiration strikes, bring it to life with Gemini.
